reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that reads local session usage events and presents token consumption through daily, weekly, and cumulative heatmaps, summaries, and activity insights.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中读取本地会话用量并以热力图、统计摘要和活动洞察展示令牌消耗。
summaries.en: Reads local DeepSeek Harness session usage and presents token consumption through heatmaps, summary statistics, and activity insights.

capabilities: Reads and parses local DeepSeek Harness session log files
Decompresses zstd session data and aggregates token usage statistics
Provides same-origin statistics, refresh, and status endpoints
Adds a settings sidebar entry with interactive heatmaps and activity insights
